title: A new teaser trailer for my freeware point and click adventure game. Link to weekly dev diary in comments
author: JussiPKemppainen

replies.author: Unreal_777
replies.body:
I want to remake the make fully but with my assets and my story, will your website help tremendousely? 

Btw, saw your stuf several months and it got me so pumped.

comments.author: EchoDiff
comments.body:
Incredibly high quality. 

And your pipeline will be the standard in the future. Insane.

replies.author: JussiPKemppainen
replies.body: For many games yes I think so.

comments.author: tadeoh
comments.body: What did you use to get these kinds of graphics?

replies.author: JussiPKemppainen
replies.body: Midjourney, stable diffusion, photoshop and blender.

replies.author: tadeoh
replies.body: It is still a lot of manual work, that should be appreciated.

replies.author: JussiPKemppainen
replies.body: This is the full work load of a project programmer, designer, writer, 3D modeler, Animator etc. So yes it is not a magic ”make game” button.

replies.author: MartialST
replies.body: What's your main field of work? It looks polished from every direction.

replies.author: JussiPKemppainen
replies.body: I have worked in so many roles! Compositing, VFX, video direction, game direction, 3D modeling, cinematography, editing. Color grading, producing. Etc… this is a fun project because I get to combine so many of my skills!

replies.author: MartialST
replies.body: Wow. I wonder how you manage to get jobs in so many different positions. This sounds like my dream career honestly haha...

replies.author: JussiPKemppainen
replies.body: I think that my career path has been just about saying "yes" to people. There are not many occasions where I have actually set out to pursue something deliberately.

comments.author: _nidaz
comments.body: Wow, I love this! and used to play loads of these kinds of games back in the day :) Looks amazing!

comments.author: Breasil131
comments.body: I am going to have to try this out. It looks beautiful!
